name: New arrival promo
description: A calm, editorial screen for a new product in a shop: a serif product name, a short description, the price and where to find it, the product on a tinted panel with a "New" sticker, and an optional QR code to the product page.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A square-ish PNG or SVG. The bundled badge is a placeholder; replace it with your own.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Turn off if you have no logo (an empty logo setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: brand
params.label: Store name
params.help: Shown beside the logo. Leave empty if your logo already says it.

params.name: sticker
params.label: Round sticker
params.help: One short word. Leave empty for a plain dot.

params.name: headline
params.label: Product name
params.help: Room for three lines; 34 characters is the most that always fits.

params.name: description
params.label: Description
params.default: Waxed canvas, vegetable-tanned leather handles and an inside zip pocket. In ink, olive and sand.

params.name: price
params.label: Price
params.help: As it should read, e.g. $148 or 1.299,00 €. Leave empty to hide.

params.name: product_image
params.label: Product picture
params.help: A cut-out PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. It is fitted, never cropped.

params.name: show_image
params.label: Show the product picture
params.help: Turn off to leave the panel without a picture (an empty picture setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: show_qr
params.label: Show the QR code
params.help: Turn off if you have no link: the code, its card and caption disappear.

params.name: qr_url
params.label: QR link
params.help: The page the code opens. Shorter links scan from further away.

params.name: small_print
params.label: Small print
params.default: While stocks last. Colours may vary from the picture.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The small heading, sticker and rules.

params.name: background_image
params.label: Background photo
params.help: Optional. A photo behind everything, darkened by the setting below.

params.name: background_dim
params.label: Darken the photo
params.help: 0 = the photo as is, 0.9 = almost black. Only used with a background photo.
